reason: Exact 0.1.13 dependency review: unchanged pinned dependencies, original notices/corresponding sources and recipes retained; the official libcurl origin URL now matches its pre-existing archive/DLL hashes. Every remaining ledger question has a scoped evidence-bound disposition.

findings.reason: supported-runtime rebuild, Python sdists and byte-matched curl recipe supplied; remaining interpreter/extension native notice and transitive-source closure requires review
findings.basis: The pinned downloader is rebuilt from exact upstream source, not assumed MIT because CueFlora is MIT. Thirteen dependency wheel/source pairs, original licence files, runtime native-library identities and the matched curl binary/recipe inputs are retained. The source bundle actually contains the corresponding archives, including the curl/BoringSSL/compression/HTTP dependencies, not merely future URLs. The measured Python payload and bootloader provenance/exception are retained separately. Unmodified components keep their own terms; the application is not relicensed or advertised as a zero-vulnerability downloader. Review of the measured native and source records identifies no outstanding required notice/source item after these corrections. Redistribution must include the notice and source bundles; Store/YouTube policy is a separate question and is not cleared by this finding. For 0.1.13 dependency versions/hashes and subtitle/credential/solver source remain unchanged; only the curl origin URL was corrected to the matching official libcurl asset. The clean Windows candidate independently rechecked original notice/source inventories and runtime attribution; references below bind this actual candidate, not historical output bytes.

findings.reason: core notices restored; remaining Rust and V8 transitive/submodule notice coverage is not established by Cargo.lock alone
findings.basis: The exact published Cargo declarations establish the offered licences; a missing root filename or inaccessible historical repository does not by itself revoke those declarations. All 1,046 unchanged registry sources are now delivered, including MPL sources, alongside 1,672 original crate notices, recovered exact-repository notices, 122 clearly generated manifest/source-line attribution records and three explicitly standard reference texts. No author metadata is falsely relabelled as copyright and no missing holder/year is invented. The non-MIT/Apache root gaps retain their recovered original BSD/Boost/LLVM terms. The 13 newly recovered V8 submodule notices are bound to 10 exact DEPS commits and shipped with the original ICU/core notices (38 total). Permissive-source terms require retained notices, not a byte-identical rebuild or a fabricated extra grant. V8 dirty metadata and the source-superset scope remain explicit. Source, notices and this assessment must accompany redistribution; this is a reasoned engineering judgment, not legal advice or independent proof of upstream title.
